name: paint/select-tool
description: Open Paint and pick the Select tool from its toolbar.
source_task: Open Paint and click the Select tool in its toolbar. This is an unattended test. Do not wait for a person. Decide yourself. Never buy, send, submit, save or delete anything. Leave the application window open when you are done.

steps.note: Windows 10 Paint calls the tool 'Select'. Windows 11 Paint calls it 'Selection'. 'contains' matches both.
Picking a tool only changes the button's state. No new element appears, so this step cannot have an expect.

then.note: If the click opened the selection-shape dropdown, choose Rectangle. That turns the Select tool on and closes the menu.
